name: 99353 · West Richland, WA
findings: ZIP 99353 (West Richland) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99353 (West Richland) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 99353 (West Richland) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

observations.text: 5 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
